{
  "service": "enterprise_math",
  "version": "0.6.11",
  "status": "CANONICAL_CONTROL_ADAPTER_TRIAL",
  "endpoint": "https://em.181131.xyz/gateway/v1/enterprise-math/mcp",
  "operation_contracts": {
    "review_flow_state": {
      "schema": "EM_DRIVER_FLOW_CONTRACT_V1",
      "operation": "review_flow_state",
      "payload_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "result_request_id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "result_request_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 128,
            "description": "Own successful artifact request with the complete verified Result JSON."
          },
          "reviewer_contribution_ids": {
            "type": "array",
            "maxItems": 100,
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "maxLength": 128
            },
            "default": [],
            "description": "Supplement, never clear, server-known prior contributions."
          }
        }
      },
      "required_role": "RESEARCH_DRIVER",
      "independence_obligations": [
        "Use your own active RESEARCH_DRIVER session and current Source DA; never borrow an earlier author identity.",
        "Declare all prior contribution IDs. Declarations supplement server-known history; a new session does not establish independence.",
        "independence_status is an explicit context disclosure, never a default, proof of independence, or exemption from contribution-overlap checks.",
        "Read the exact Result and complete review set; finding records the actual semantic or adversarial analysis and any context limitations.",
        "Preserve immutable existing passes/authors. Consume an identical existing pass; read current state when it differs.",
        "No enum, successful transport, reference pass, or synthesis grants mathematical acceptance, Working Truth, Foundation, or P000 changes."
      ],
      "source_contract_ref": "5c37cb9ba03dec2e0ad4854addde51fb81811b31",
      "native_validation_required": true,
      "workflow_prerequisites": "Own complete verified Result artifact and active session-bound Driver authority."
    },
    "review_reference": {
      "schema": "EM_DRIVER_FLOW_CONTRACT_V1",
      "operation": "review_reference",
      "payload_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "result_request_id",
          "pass_number",
          "finding",
          "independence_status"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "result_request_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 128,
            "description": "Own successful artifact request with the complete verified Result JSON."
          },
          "reviewer_contribution_ids": {
            "type": "array",
            "maxItems": 100,
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "maxLength": 128
            },
            "default": [],
            "description": "Supplement, never clear, server-known prior contributions."
          },
          "pass_number": {
            "type": "integer",
            "enum": [
              1,
              2
            ],
            "description": "1: SEMANTIC_EVIDENCE_CROSSCHECK; 2: ADVERSARIAL_CONTROL_CROSSCHECK. Complete in order."
          },
          "finding": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 12000,
            "description": "Nonblank actual analysis of the exact review set, including independence/context disclosure. Not an enum."
          },
          "independence_status": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 80,
            "enum": [
              "CLEAN_INDEPENDENT_CONTEXT",
              "SHARED_CONTROL_CONTEXT_DISCLOSED",
              "NOT_INDEPENDENT",
              "NOT_APPLICABLE"
            ],
            "description": "Explicit truthful context classification; no default. Put prose explanation in finding."
          }
        }
      },
      "required_role": "RESEARCH_DRIVER",
      "independence_obligations": [
        "Use your own active RESEARCH_DRIVER session and current Source DA; never borrow an earlier author identity.",
        "Declare all prior contribution IDs. Declarations supplement server-known history; a new session does not establish independence.",
        "independence_status is an explicit context disclosure, never a default, proof of independence, or exemption from contribution-overlap checks.",
        "Read the exact Result and complete review set; finding records the actual semantic or adversarial analysis and any context limitations.",
        "Preserve immutable existing passes/authors. Consume an identical existing pass; read current state when it differs.",
        "No enum, successful transport, reference pass, or synthesis grants mathematical acceptance, Working Truth, Foundation, or P000 changes."
      ],
      "source_contract_ref": "5c37cb9ba03dec2e0ad4854addde51fb81811b31",
      "native_validation_required": true,
      "workflow_prerequisites": "At least two exact-set reviews; pass 1 precedes pass 2. Read existing passes before mutation.",
      "independence_meanings": {
        "CLEAN_INDEPENDENT_CONTEXT": "Assert only if the actual context is clean and independent.",
        "SHARED_CONTROL_CONTEXT_DISCLOSED": "Shared control context is disclosed; explain its extent in finding.",
        "NOT_INDEPENDENT": "Explicitly disclose that the context is not independent; this never bypasses author/contribution checks.",
        "NOT_APPLICABLE": "Explicitly explain why a context-independence classification is not applicable; this never bypasses author/contribution checks."
      }
    },
    "review_synthesize": {
      "schema": "EM_DRIVER_FLOW_CONTRACT_V1",
      "operation": "review_synthesize",
      "payload_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "result_request_id",
          "disposition",
          "rationale",
          "destination_class"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "result_request_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 128,
            "description": "Own successful artifact request with the complete verified Result JSON."
          },
          "reviewer_contribution_ids": {
            "type": "array",
            "maxItems": 100,
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "maxLength": 128
            },
            "default": [],
            "description": "Supplement, never clear, server-known prior contributions."
          },
          "disposition": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 80,
            "enum": [
              "ACCEPTED",
              "REJECTED",
              "PARKED",
              "CLOSED",
              "SUPERSEDED",
              "RETURN_TO_OWNER",
              "REQUEST_REPLICATION",
              "REQUEST_REVISION"
            ]
          },
          "rationale": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 12000,
            "description": "Explicit judgment after both exact-set reference passes; no automatic ACCEPTED choice."
          },
          "destination_class": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 80,
            "enum": [
              "NONE",
              "FOUNDATION",
              "TOOL",
              "L4",
              "REPLICATION",
              "FOLLOWUP_TASK",
              "ARCHIVE"
            ]
          },
          "destination_ref_or_none": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 2000,
            "default": ""
          }
        }
      },
      "required_role": "RESEARCH_DRIVER",
      "independence_obligations": [
        "Use your own active RESEARCH_DRIVER session and current Source DA; never borrow an earlier author identity.",
        "Declare all prior contribution IDs. Declarations supplement server-known history; a new session does not establish independence.",
        "independence_status is an explicit context disclosure, never a default, proof of independence, or exemption from contribution-overlap checks.",
        "Read the exact Result and complete review set; finding records the actual semantic or adversarial analysis and any context limitations.",
        "Preserve immutable existing passes/authors. Consume an identical existing pass; read current state when it differs.",
        "No enum, successful transport, reference pass, or synthesis grants mathematical acceptance, Working Truth, Foundation, or P000 changes."
      ],
      "source_contract_ref": "5c37cb9ba03dec2e0ad4854addde51fb81811b31",
      "native_validation_required": true,
      "workflow_prerequisites": "Both current exact-set reference passes. Retain every source review; no latest-timestamp selection."
    },
    "followup_materialize": {
      "schema": "EM_DRIVER_FLOW_CONTRACT_V1",
      "operation": "followup_materialize",
      "payload_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "result_request_id",
          "publication_request_id",
          "followup_spec_filename"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "result_request_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 128,
            "description": "Own successful artifact request with the complete verified Result JSON."
          },
          "reviewer_contribution_ids": {
            "type": "array",
            "maxItems": 100,
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "maxLength": 128
            },
            "default": [],
            "description": "Supplement, never clear, server-known prior contributions."
          },
          "publication_request_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 128,
            "description": "Own successful driver_publish request from this same active session."
          },
          "followup_spec_filename": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 96,
            "description": "Exact published filename containing a native follow-up spec JSON object."
          }
        }
      },
      "required_role": "RESEARCH_DRIVER",
      "independence_obligations": [
        "Use your own active RESEARCH_DRIVER session and current Source DA; never borrow an earlier author identity.",
        "Declare all prior contribution IDs. Declarations supplement server-known history; a new session does not establish independence.",
        "independence_status is an explicit context disclosure, never a default, proof of independence, or exemption from contribution-overlap checks.",
        "Read the exact Result and complete review set; finding records the actual semantic or adversarial analysis and any context limitations.",
        "Preserve immutable existing passes/authors. Consume an identical existing pass; read current state when it differs.",
        "No enum, successful transport, reference pass, or synthesis grants mathematical acceptance, Working Truth, Foundation, or P000 changes."
      ],
      "source_contract_ref": "5c37cb9ba03dec2e0ad4854addde51fb81811b31",
      "native_validation_required": true,
      "workflow_prerequisites": "Current operational authority (one review or exact-set synthesis), own same-session driver_publish, explicit native spec and task/closure admission.",
      "followup_spec_contract": {
        "required": [
          "decision",
          "gate_decisions"
        ],
        "decision_enum": [
          "TASK_SET_PUBLISHED",
          "PARENT_OBJECTIVE_CLOSURE",
          "TASK_SCOPE_CLOSURE_PORTFOLIO_CONTINUATION",
          "EXISTING_CONTROL_ASSET_BOUND"
        ],
        "tasks_default": [],
        "gate_decisions": {
          "exact_gate_set": [
            "MATHEMATICAL_CONTINUATION",
            "LEAN_FORMALIZATION",
            "EXTERNAL_PRIOR_ART_DUPLICATION",
            "INDEPENDENT_REPLICATION",
            "INTEGRATION_OR_TOOL_HARVEST",
            "ADVERSARIAL_AUDIT"
          ],
          "decision_enum": [
            "REQUIRED",
            "SATISFIED_BY_REVIEWED_RESULT",
            "SATISFIED_BY_EXISTING_CONTROL_ASSET",
            "NOT_REQUIRED"
          ],
          "required_row_fields": [
            "gate",
            "decision",
            "reason"
          ],
          "field_types": {
            "gate": "string",
            "decision": "string",
            "reason": "nonblank string",
            "evidence_refs": "array of unique nonblank strings, default []"
          },
          "evidence_refs": "Nonempty evidence refs required for either SATISFIED_BY_* decision.",
          "rules": [
            "Exactly one row per gate.",
            "REQUIRED needs a matching published task role.",
            "ACCEPTED cannot skip external prior art; ACCEPTED L4 cannot skip Lean; tool-bearing results cannot skip tool harvest."
          ]
        },
        "tasks": {
          "required_fields": [
            "task_id",
            "title",
            "task_role",
            "frontier",
            "next_action",
            "research_value",
            "mother_question",
            "frozen_inputs_and_scope",
            "hard_target_and_required_outputs",
            "research_value_to_preserve",
            "success_kill_and_return_criteria"
          ],
          "task_role_enum": [
            "MATHEMATICAL_CONTINUATION",
            "LEAN_FORMALIZATION",
            "EXTERNAL_PRIOR_ART_DUPLICATION",
            "INDEPENDENT_REPLICATION",
            "INTEGRATION_OR_TOOL_HARVEST",
            "ADVERSARIAL_AUDIT",
            "REVISION",
            "PARALLEL_REFERENCE_OR_SYNTHESIS",
            "OTHER"
          ],
          "task_lineage_enum": [
            "NEW_DIRECTION",
            "CONTINUATION",
            "REPLAY",
            "INTEGRATION",
            "MAINTENANCE"
          ],
          "defaults": {
            "task_lineage": "CONTINUATION",
            "kind": "RESEARCH",
            "owner": "taskbook/unassigned",
            "priority": "P1",
            "leverage": "HIGH",
            "dependencies": [],
            "source_refs": [],
            "claim_lease_minutes": 120
          },
          "continuation_requires": [
            "parent_task_id",
            "successor_gate"
          ],
          "native_task_admission": "Task schema, successor gate, objective binding and publication preflight remain mandatory."
        },
        "decision_conditions": {
          "TASK_SET_PUBLISHED": "One or more substantive tasks; preserve Result successor restrictions and parent Objective.",
          "PARENT_OBJECTIVE_CLOSURE": "No tasks or REQUIRED gates; parent Objective must already be canonically CLOSED.",
          "TASK_SCOPE_CLOSURE_PORTFOLIO_CONTINUATION": "No tasks or REQUIRED gates; accepted PASS/SUCCESS Task with SATISFIED hard target or the native pinned explicit Driver satisfaction assessment. Requires terminal_scope=TASK and portfolio_continuation; grants no parent completion.",
          "EXISTING_CONTROL_ASSET_BOUND": "No new tasks or REQUIRED gates. Bind exactly the existing integration publication named by an ACCEPTED/FOLLOWUP_TASK exact-set synthesis. Require the current source Task publication, own active Driver session/DA, and current operational destination; any later destination generation requires explicit current_destination_continuation. Preserve historical authors and grant no Task or parent closure."
        },
        "conditional_required_fields": {
          "TASK_SCOPE_CLOSURE_PORTFOLIO_CONTINUATION": [
            "terminal_scope",
            "portfolio_continuation"
          ],
          "EXISTING_CONTROL_ASSET_BOUND": [
            "existing_task_publications"
          ]
        },
        "existing_task_publications": {
          "type": "array",
          "minItems": 1,
          "maxItems": 1,
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "required": [
              "task_id",
              "publication_id",
              "task_role"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "task_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "description": "Exact synthesis destination Task ID."
              },
              "publication_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "description": "Exact original synthesis destination publication ID; never replace it with a later generation."
              },
              "task_role": {
                "type": "string",
                "const": "INTEGRATION_OR_TOOL_HARVEST"
              }
            }
          },
          "rules": [
            "Only valid for EXISTING_CONTROL_ASSET_BOUND; tasks must be empty.",
            "The original destination must be a Driver-published INTEGRATION Task in the same parent Objective.",
            "INTEGRATION_OR_TOOL_HARVEST must use SATISFIED_BY_EXISTING_CONTROL_ASSET and cite task_id/publication_id.",
            "Other gates cannot use this integration asset as satisfaction evidence; no gate may remain REQUIRED.",
            "The native writer pins raw publication bytes and taskbook blobs and preserves the original publisher; existing references are not newly published tasks."
          ]
        },
        "current_destination_continuation": {
          "type": "object",
          "required": [
            "publication_id",
            "rationale",
            "evidence_refs"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": {
            "publication_id": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "description": "Explicit current operational publication of the same destination Task, later than the exact synthesis destination."
            },
            "rationale": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "pattern": "\\S",
              "description": "Current Driver judgment explaining why this continuation preserves the synthesis routing."
            },
            "evidence_refs": {
              "type": "array",
              "minItems": 2,
              "uniqueItems": true,
              "items": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "pattern": "\\S"
              },
              "description": "Must include both task_id/original_publication_id and task_id/current_publication_id."
            }
          },
          "rules": [
            "Optional only for EXISTING_CONTROL_ASSET_BOUND; no implicit advance to a newer publication.",
            "The entire supersedes chain must reach the exact original destination and preserve Task ID and parent Objective.",
            "Every chain publication must be Driver-published INTEGRATION or MAINTENANCE; the original remains INTEGRATION.",
            "The native writer generates and verifies every raw publication/taskbook pin; callers do not supply chain pins.",
            "No synthesis rewrite, duplicate Task, closure, or change of historical authorship is authorized."
          ]
        },
        "terminal_scope": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "TASK",
          "description": "Explicitly required for TASK_SCOPE_CLOSURE_PORTFOLIO_CONTINUATION; no inferred closure."
        },
        "portfolio_continuation": {
          "required_fields": [
            "source_result_id",
            "parent_objective_id",
            "action",
            "dispatcher",
            "next_action",
            "remaining_parent_scope",
            "evidence_refs"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": {
            "source_result_id": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "Exact current Result ID."
            },
            "parent_objective_id": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "Exact parent Objective ID from current publication."
            },
            "action": {
              "type": "string",
              "const": "REEVALUATE_CANONICAL_PORTFOLIO"
            },
            "dispatcher": {
              "type": "string",
              "const": "research_control_dispatch.py"
            },
            "next_action": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "pattern": "\\S"
            },
            "remaining_parent_scope": {
              "type": "array",
              "minItems": 1,
              "uniqueItems": true,
              "items": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "pattern": "\\S"
              }
            },
            "evidence_refs": {
              "type": "array",
              "minItems": 1,
              "uniqueItems": true,
              "items": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "pattern": "\\S"
              }
            }
          },
          "action": "REEVALUATE_CANONICAL_PORTFOLIO",
          "dispatcher": "research_control_dispatch.py"
        },
        "authoritative_contract": "research_driver_followup_contract.json",
        "authoritative_writers": [
          "research_driver_followup_guard.py",
          "research_driver_followup.py"
        ]
      }
    },
    "session_preserve_staging": {
      "schema": "EM_SESSION_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CONTRACT_V1",
      "operation": "session_preserve_staging",
      "payload_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reason"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reason": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 2000,
            "pattern": "\\S"
          }
        }
      },
      "server_bound_fields": [
        "subject",
        "session_id",
        "execution_id",
        "prior_contribution_ids"
      ],
      "scope": "Own currently bound active logical conversation only. No client session/identity selector.",
      "preconditions": [
        "No pending native/admitted mutation for this session or run.",
        "No current Source LEASED own claim. Historical run state is not current authority; an own active Driver DA is preserved until the ordinary close transaction revokes it."
      ],
      "preserves": [
        "All unresolved complete and incomplete staged UTF-8 parts and hashes; inventory is not limited to 16 uploads.",
        "Original upload request IDs, predecessor session and immutable payload/receipt hashes.",
        "Existing Source checkpoint/Result/review/task bytes and prior contribution history."
      ],
      "effect": "Neutral immutable Source manifest plus typed disposition audit. Local original rows remain immutable; no published_uploads spoofing.",
      "authority_granted": false,
      "research_progress_claimed": false,
      "maximum_manifest_bytes": 4194304,
      "success_next_action": "Read verified manifest pins, session_close the old session, then session_start a fresh real identity in the same actual logical conversation. Read continuation and preserve its native checkpoint; continuation_prepare uses packet_request_id and reason only when a native frontier exists.",
      "unknown_next_action": "Use recovery_status and reconcile the original preservation request; never replace an unknown mutation with a new request ID.",
      "definite_failure_next_action": "Read the exact error and current Source ownership; resolve the stated precondition, then submit one corrected new request ID. Do not reuse a rejected identity to prepare succession."
    },
    "freeze": {
      "operation": "freeze",
      "metadata_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "hard_target_disposition",
          "independence_status",
          "method_harvest",
          "next_control_plane_recommendation",
          "source_exposure_status",
          "terminal_verdict",
          "unresolved_residue"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {
          "method_harvest": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "CANDIDATE_NOT_TOOL",
              "DOMAIN_FACADE",
              "DOMAIN_OPERATOR",
              "DUPLICATE_ALIAS",
              "GLOBAL_SUBTOOL",
              "GLOBAL_TOOL_FAMILY",
              "NO_TOOL_PAYLOAD",
              "RESULT_ONLY"
            ]
          },
          "independence_status": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "CLEAN_INDEPENDENT_CONTEXT",
              "NOT_APPLICABLE",
              "NOT_INDEPENDENT",
              "SHARED_AMBIENT_CONTEXT_DISCLOSED"
            ]
          },
          "source_exposure_status": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "BLIND_RAW_FROZEN",
              "NONBLIND_DISCLOSED",
              "NOT_APPLICABLE",
              "SOURCE_EXPOSED_AFTER_RAW_FREEZE"
            ]
          },
          "terminal_verdict": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "\\S"
          },
          "hard_target_disposition": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "\\S"
          },
          "unresolved_residue": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "\\S"
          },
          "next_control_plane_recommendation": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "\\S"
          }
        }
      },
      "native_validation_required": true,
      "source_enum_reference": {
        "repository": "awdawmip/enterprise-math",
        "commit": "012706a3ac1e42acbd86cab977afac7659264992",
        "path": "control_plane/research_result_records_impl.py"
      },
      "enum_error": {
        "code": "INVALID_NATIVE_ENUM_FIELD",
        "fields": [
          "independence_status",
          "method_harvest",
          "source_exposure_status"
        ],
        "details": [
          "code",
          "field",
          "allowed_values"
        ],
        "rejected_value_disclosed": false
      },
      "recovery": "Read/reconcile the original request ID. Existing request IDs keep their original receipts and payloads; staged plans retain native_payload. Metadata preflight applies when constructing a new plan.",
      "authority": "Own current run, session, winning CLAIM, published return, native intent, ownership epoch and Source CAS gates still apply."
    },
    "driver_runtime_observe": {
      "schema": "ENTERPRISE_MATH_DRIVER_RUNTIME_OBSERVATION_CONTRACT_V1",
      "operation": "driver_runtime_observe",
      "read_only": true,
      "payload_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "task_id",
          "expected_publication_id",
          "objective_id",
          "expected_objective_generation_id",
          "expected_source_head"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "task_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 128,
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "expected_publication_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 128,
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "objective_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 128,
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "expected_objective_generation_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 128,
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "expected_source_head": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{40}$"
          }
        }
      },
      "authority": "BACKEND_AS_OF_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPOSITION",
      "replay": "Same request returns the original observation; use a new request for a fresh collection.",
      "closure_authorized": false,
      "claim_authorized": false,
      "final_permission_granted": false,
      "all_ingress_fence_proved": false
    },
    "historical_result_control": {

freeze.authority: Own current run, session, winning CLAIM, published return, native intent, ownership epoch and Source CAS gates still apply.
